Initial release of dlazy-viduq2-i2v.

- Converts static images into dynamic videos using the Vidu Q2 image-to-video model.
- Provides a CLI with flexible options for prompt, images, audio, duration, aspect ratio, resolution, watermark, and more.
- Includes detailed error handling and guides for resolving insufficient credits or missing API key issues.
- Outputs video links upon success.
